tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover certificate as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Each tenderer in its name should have in the Last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed at least one similar works of value not less than Rs. 29.50 lakhs, as prime contractor

Tenderer shall provide Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 18.00 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement in format Given
Tenderer should have valid PF and ESI Registration. ESI and EPF paid challans for the last Six months should be uploaded
Tenderer should have valid registration certificate issued by Labour department, Government of Karnataka
The tenderer should have in his/Firm name Registered GST Certificate

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the Last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs. 59.80 Lakhs
